learning_signal: On supply/decide signatures with an equilibrium model, equilibrium arithmetic is necessary but not sufficient for systems policy: after computing the steady state the m011 contract must output the collapse threshold and the operating point's distance to it (never dismiss it as 'extreme'), the delay's transition behavior mode (overshoot/oscillation and which lagged indicator management will wrongly steer by), and the recommendation placed on the leverage hierarchy (rule/parameter > flow > buffer) — flow-level fixes near a threshold are fragile and move the cliff toward the operating point.
